title: P17b — Verify portable bundles on the production Linux x86_64 target
description: D10 selects AWS Batch Fargate Linux x86_64. P17a correctly proves only darwin-arm64 and linux-arm64-glibc; the production target currently rejects runtime selection. Preserve that accepted scope and add explicit linux-x64-glibc support before cloud drills/cutover. Owning repos: toolchain, CLI tests if needed, specification. Add strict Node platform/libc identification, native @esbuild/linux-x64 same-version pins and ELF64 little-endian EM_X86_64 verification; retain all v1 behavior, complete target closures, VideoML identical-content requirement and fail-closed unsupported/musl behavior. No generic optional-dependency skipping. Add schema examples and malformed native/architecture tests. Use immutable same six VideoML tarballs in clean offline macOS and actual Linux x86_64 consumers; QEMU is acceptable local functional evidence only if explicitly labeled, never as Fargate/performance proof. Reuse tracked P17a XML/font/PCM and trustedTS/shader fixtures: same unchanged ZIP on both hosts, actual outputs, complete frame/audio counts, PCM/font/source/timing identity, native tamper negative. Inspect available images first; pin and inventory any x86_64 image and obtain primary bounded acquisition approval before downloads. No cloud calls/deployment; D16 one heavy operation and8GiB free floor. Initial new image/cache+scratch reservation at most5GiB aggregate; report measured sizes and stop on bound. P26 still requires actual dedicated-account production architecture drills. Return reviewed source, reproducible evidence and exact package/image hashes; primary closes only after landing.
